items.q: Finally, Faulkenberg said to me-- another man that encouraged me to get a big band

ctx.x: Poker, craps, anything; he was just a gambler, and would gamble on all the guys' money.

Finally, Faulkenberg said to me-- another man that encouraged me to get a big band--right at that same time, he said he had a talk with the band. He said you all are getting to be too much of a headache; he said, can anybody run the band? He said I don't have anything against T, but it's too much headache. He said I'm surprised you all are not tired of it. I pay him, he goes to Dallas, half the time he's losing money, you're begging me for money, you owe your hotel bill, you got nothing to eat and everything. He…
